name: squat-barbell
title: Squat: Barbell
primer: This is an exercise for leg strengthening, mainly the quadriceps.
steps: Lifting a barbell off of a weight rack, position it on your shoulders.
Place your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart with your knees and toes pointed slightly outward.
Drawing your abs in, descend slowly by bending at the knees and hips as if you are sitting down (squatting).
Lower yourself as far as you can control without letting your body shift towards your toes (this will cause you to lose balance).
Pause in the downward position and slowly return upright to the starting position.
